summary: Ubuntu 24.04, /dev/ttyACM0: read started 17:43:38, transfer began ~17:46:07 (184 frames in 5 s), then a permission-denied/in-use error at 17:46:15. The port had opened, so dialout is unlikely; suspect the device dropping and re-enumerating or ModemManager grabbing the CDC-ACM port. The message wrongly says "could not open".
title: Linux 1.0.79: port reported denied/in use after the read was already transferring
